options.text: There is a mirror in the bathroom.
There are a mirror in the bathroom.
There a mirror in the bathroom.

questions.explanation: Mirror (зеркало) — единственное число, значит there is.

options.text: There are five chairs in the kitchen.
There is five chairs in the kitchen.
There chairs five in the kitchen.

questions.explanation: Five chairs — множественное число, значит there are.

questions.text: В каких предложениях there is / there are употреблены верно? (выбери все верные варианты)

options.text: There is a TV in the living room.
There are two cats in the garden.
There is three windows in my room.
There aren't any flowers on the balcony.
There are a computer on the desk.

questions.explanation: A TV — ед. ч. (there is), two cats — мн. ч. (there are), any flowers — мн. ч. (there aren't). Three windows требует there are, а a computer — there is.

questions.text: ___ there a fridge in the kitchen?

options.text: Is
Are
Do

questions.explanation: A fridge — единственное число, вопрос: Is there...?

questions.text: There ___ any pictures on the walls (картин нет).

options.text: aren't
isn't
don't

questions.explanation: Pictures — множественное число, отрицание: there aren't.

questions.text: Впиши is или are: There ___ a carpet on the floor. (На полу есть ковёр.)
questions.explanation: A carpet — единственное число, значит there is.

questions.text: Впиши краткий положительный ответ на вопрос «Are there any chairs in the garden?»: Yes, there ___.
questions.explanation: Chairs — множественное число, краткий ответ: Yes, there are.

pairs.left: There is a clock on the wall.
There are three beds in the room.
There isn't a lift in our house.
Is there a bus stop near your house?
pairs.right: Рядом с твоим домом есть остановка?

questions.explanation: There is — есть (ед. ч.), there are — есть (мн. ч.), there isn't — нет, Is there...? — есть ли...?

questions.text: There are four flats on each floor. Что значит это предложение?

options.text: На каждом этаже четыре квартиры.
На каждом этаже есть квартира.
На этаже нет квартир.

questions.explanation: There are + four flats — «есть четыре квартиры», on each floor — «на каждом этаже».
